scientific_summary: For iid sampling from an arbitrary probability measure with atom masses p_i and nonatomic mass q, the first-repeat survival EGF is e^{qz} product_i(1+p_i z). Its zero multiset recovers all p_i, while log coefficients recover every collision power sum. If there are at most m atoms, survival probabilities through 2m+1 suffice by a finite Vandermonde moment argument.
limitations: Structural rather than stable statistical identification; no recovery of atom locations or nonatomic shape; finite-horizon bound not claimed optimal; Stein (1990) and theorem-level content of Camarri-Pitman (2000) leave residual originality uncertainty; no independent audit has been performed.
